surprises: NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S1: fetch_day takes no G, so a multi-G run in one session fetches the signed-in G's day under every G key. Closed by REPAIR 1 (one domain walk); ARMED until the issuer's ruling is read.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S2: the planner's KINDS, status words and EMPTY-as-skip did not match the adapter. Closed by REPAIR 2: the adapter and box command conform to backfill.py's vocabulary.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S3: calendar-day windows and holiday empty listings read as retention. Closed by REPAIR 1: non-trading days are skipped and three consecutive empty trading days are the stop.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S4: fetch_day returns the same listing for an empty status list and a partial day; the adapter counts the status rows itself. INERT.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S5: FetchError carries the HTTP status only in its message text and a refused download never raises. INERT.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S6: the completion record's stop enumeration has no session-cap value; a refused run is recorded as reason none with evidence session cap reached. INERT.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S7: the runner interface was undefined in reference section 12; the runner now exists and main conforms to it. INERT.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S8: the criterion's relative checker path reaches a worktree copy whose md5 differs from the main-tree copy; both print the same verdict for ft7. INERT.

NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S9: BLOCKING for the live walk: the runner accepted only the planner's kinds and the planner needed COMPLETED and bytes where the adapter returned served and a folder. Closed by REPAIR 2 (commit 2d7e342d657) through the real planner and runner on fakes.

NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S10: the runner counted skipped non-trading days against max_exports_per_run. Closed by REPAIR 2 (commit 2d7e342d657): the client's is_skipped answers them with no channel request and they cost nothing.

NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W8-S11: the REPAIR 3 premise 'one DAY line per job' fails: the planner waits each trading day once per kind, so two non-skipped jobs reach the tap per day. Resolved by one DAY line and one days entry per trading day (the first wait is the answer, the repeat is answered from the day cache). INERT. Row committed at 7365a848667.
